cohort: Patients who experienced substantial blood loss from lower genital tract trauma during childbirth and received chitosan-covered gauze intravaginally or locally at the vulva at a university hospital between 2017 and 2024.
finding: Vaginal insertion of chitosan-covered gauze was found to be safe and effective for controlling severe bleeding due to lower genital tract trauma after vaginal birth, with bleeding effectively controlled in 26 out of 27 cases.
mod_finding: The study found chitosan-covered gauze to be safe and effective for managing severe lacerations after vaginal birth.
